build_cosine_weights_module: build a CosineWeights module to compute cosine similarity attention weights over memory slots
create_temporal_linkage: create a TemporalLinkage module to track write order and build link graphs for temporal addressing
compute_directional_read_weights: compute forward or backward directional read weights from the TemporalLinkage link graphs
build_freeness_module: build a Freeness module to track memory usage and allocate free slots for writing
apply_weighted_softmax: apply weighted softmax to activations using strengths and a strength operation
